text: Study layer: recall drill with staged reveal and keyboard-only sessions, Clean / Patchy / Blank ratings shown on the map and in Progress, confusable pairs drawn from your connections, printable reference sheets, offline install, ratings sync by code, and this version panel. Map: course names and the centre mark keep the same proportions on every screen, the course view always holds the whole course, and subjects open as subtopic tiles listing their entries instead of a bulleted list.
